description: This file provides database connection pooling, transaction handling, query execution, and table truncation functions for a SQL database, specifically designed for use with MySQL via the cloudsql-proxy. It manages connection pooling, handles transactions for inserting multiple rows, performs select queries with row processing, and supports truncating tables.

methods.name: newDBConnectionPool
methods.description: Creates and returns a new database connection pool configured for Google Cloud SQL MySQL instances.

methods.name: maxParallelism
methods.description: Determines the maximum degree of parallelism based on runtime settings and CPU count.

methods.name: GetDBConnectionPool
methods.description: Provides a singleton database connection pool, initializing it if necessary with appropriate max connections.

methods.name: SingleTransactionInsert
methods.description: Performs a batch insert within a single transaction for multiple rows of data.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: Executes a query and processes each result row with a provided handler function.

methods.name: TruncateTable
methods.description: Executes a TRUNCATE TABLE statement for a specified table.
